# Configuration {#sec-configuration}

AEE registers all settings with `CBA_fnc_addSetting`, passing the
`[category, subCategory]` array form. They appear in the CBA Settings menu
(Addons) under the **AEE Core** and **AEE Mobility** parent categories,
with collapsible sub-categories beneath (Temperature, Wind, Biome, and
the rest). Values marked *global* must match across all clients.

## AEE Core

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_enabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Master switch for the AEE environment simulation module. |
| `aee_core_updateInterval` | SLIDER | `[1, 60, 5, 0]` (default 5) | yes | Simulation update interval in seconds, where lower values give more frequent updates. |
| `aee_core_referenceAltitude` | SLIDER | `[-500, 8000, 0, 0]` (default 0) | yes | Override reference altitude for station pressure calculations, where 0 = auto-detect from unit position. |
| `aee_core_clothingInsulation` | SLIDER | `[0.5, 2.0, 1.0, 1]` (default 1.0) | yes | Multiplier for clothing insulation, where higher values keep the soldier warmer in cold conditions. |
| `aee_core_diagnostic` | CHECKBOX | false | no | Enable verbose diagnostic logging for environment state changes. |

## AEE Core → Temperature

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_tempLapseRateEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable the elevation-based temperature lapse rate of the standard atmosphere. |
| `aee_core_tempLapseRate` | SLIDER | `[0, 15, 6.5, 1]` (default 6.5) | yes | Temperature lapse rate in °C per 1000 m, with the ICAO standard at 6.5 °C/km. |
| `aee_core_tempDiurnalEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable diurnal temperature variation based on solar elevation angle. |

## AEE Core → Wind

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_windEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable dynamic wind simulation with terrain and thermal influences. |
| `aee_core_windTerrainInfluence` | SLIDER | `[0, 1, 0.6, 1]` (default 0.6) | yes | Strength of terrain effects on wind vectors, from ridge channelling and valley funnelling. |
| `aee_core_windGustFrequency` | SLIDER | `[0, 1, 0.3, 1]` (default 0.3) | yes | Relative frequency of gust events, from calm to very gusty. |

## AEE Core → Humidity

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_humidityEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable relative-humidity tracking and condensation and precipitation calculations. |
| `aee_core_precipOrographicEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable orographic-lifting precipitation enhancement on windward slopes. |

## AEE Core → Air Density

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_airDensityEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Calculate density altitude and true air density from temperature, pressure, and humidity corrections. |
| `aee_core_icaoReferenceAlt` | SLIDER | `[-500, 5000, 0, 0]` (default 0) | yes | Reference altitude for the ICAO standard atmosphere baseline. |

## AEE Core → Biome

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_biomeEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Use Köppen climate classification to differentiate biome types and their weather characteristics. |
| `aee_core_biomeTransitionRadius` | SLIDER | `[500, 50000, 5000, 0]` (default 5000) | yes | Smoothing radius for biome boundary transitions to avoid hard climatic edges. |

## AEE Core → Microclimate

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_microclimateRadius` | SLIDER | `[10, 2000, 200, 0]` (default 200) | yes | Radius for local terrain and vegetation microclimate effects, such as valley cool-air pooling and forest canopy. |
| `aee_core_urbanHeatIsland` | SLIDER | `[0, 1, 0.5, 1]` (default 0.5) | yes | Magnitude of the urban heat-island temperature boost in built-up areas. |
| `aee_core_waterInfluenceRadius` | SLIDER | `[100, 10000, 1000, 0]` (default 1000) | yes | Radius over which large water bodies moderate local temperature and humidity. |

## AEE Core → Mud

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_mudAccretionEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable mud build-up on vehicle wheels and tracks when driving on muddy terrain. |

## AEE Core → Radio / Comms

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_radioPropagationEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Compute radio link quality from the Friis path loss with atmospheric ducting and HF ionospheric absorption. |

## AEE Core → Vehicle Performance

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_enginePowerDegradationEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Reduce ground-vehicle engine power in hot and high conditions using density-altitude derating. |

## AEE Core → Optics / Visibility

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_opticsEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable thermal contrast, mirage and heat haze, smoke dispersal persistence, precipitation visibility reduction, and solar glare. |

## AEE Core → Ground / Hydrology

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_hydrologyEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable snow accumulation, melt and drifting, flash flood risk in arid terrain, and freeze-thaw state cycling. |

## AEE Core → Atmospheric Events

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_atmosphericEventsEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable lightning strike risk, severe weather, microburst downdrafts, low-level turbulence, and avalanche risk. |

## AEE Core → Environmental

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_environmentalEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable CBRN persistence, biological ambient sound, lunar illumination, and frost. |
| `aee_core_physiologyEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable heat stress, WBGT, wind chill, dehydration, hypoxia, UV index, and scent dispersion. |
| `aee_core_maritimeEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable sea state, wave height, tidal prediction, and magnetic compass deviation. |
| `aee_core_fxEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Enable environmental particles, wind noise, rain sounds, and severe-weather visual effects. |

## AEE Mobility

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_mobility_flightTurbulence` | CHECKBOX | true | yes | Apply atmospheric turbulence, gusts, and wind-shear forces to aircraft. |
| `aee_mobility_turbulenceScale` | SLIDER | `[0, 3, 1, 1]` (default 1) | yes | Multiplier for the strength of applied turbulence forces, from off to severe. |
| `aee_mobility_turbulenceRadius` | SLIDER | `[500, 5000, 2000, 0]` (default 2000) | yes | Distance from the player or mission centre within which aircraft receive turbulence forces. |
